abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Desperate Feat
abilities.description: While you have at least one moderate or major wound, you add +1 Edge to the Pool of your choice.

abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on. At tier 2: You can choose to become specialized in the same attack method you chose at tier 1, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement). At tier 6: You can become an expert in a specific attack method (either the one you chose at tier 1 or another weapon skill you’re already specialized in), but you must gain the skill normally. For a Heavy, Expert Combatant also means choosing training in weapons appropriate to the genre, such as pistols and rifles.

system.description:
